summary.intent: Land fixes for code-review findings across a stack of PR branches (callisto release-preview work): resolve the #74 findings, write PR #467's description and stack it, then address the two new findings on #75/PR #467.
summary.outcome: Merged the rebase-entry-headings fix into emit-release-preview, resolved both #74 findings, updated PR #467 and linked the stack (463, 464, 466, 467), then fixed and pushed the two #75 findings (clean-plan gating and workspace-root path resolution). Resolving the #75 findings and the codebase-wide audit were still pending at the end.

repo: Markdown fence handling is centralized in a shared Fences tracker (changelog/fences.rs) used by headings.rs, find_section and has_heading; it handles a fence opened on a list item and closed indented.
Heading titles keep a literal trailing hash (e.g. C#); only an ATX closing sequence preceded by a space is stripped.
PRs are stacked with `gh stack link 463 464 466 467`.
Review findings are managed through the `entire trail finding` CLI, which is per-branch.

Work happens in the worktree .claude/worktrees/macos-15-runners; verification is cargo fmt, cargo test -p callisto-cli --test emit_preview_tests, and cargo clippy -D warnings on callisto-graph and callisto-cli.

code.finding: `version --emit-preview` wrote the preview file even when the plan had errors; it now gates on a clean plan and writes under the workspace root.
`compose-pr-body --preview` read a relative path from the process cwd while `version` wrote it under the workspace root; the path is now resolved from the workspace root.

workflow: `entire trail finding resolve` needs `--branch <branch>` to locate a finding outside its branch context.
Scripted find/replace edits break after `cargo fmt` reshapes the code; format first or match the formatted text.
Poll findings with `--json` to confirm the full set before committing and resolving.

friction: `entire trail finding resolve` failed the first time without `--branch`, requiring a retry.
The first preview_fix.py patch didn't match after cargo fmt reformatted the code, requiring a manual Edit and a second script (preview_fix2.py).
A stray no-op `sed -i` command was run against the fix script and was abandoned.
open_items: Resolve the two #75 findings on PR #467 with `entire trail finding resolve` after the push.
Audit the rest of the codebase for the same patterns (ungated preview writes and cwd-relative paths).
Check the other stacked changes (feat/release-pr-headlines, feat/release-notes-model) for findings.
